Is utilisation your #1 constraint right now?

The tell: you own the capacity and it sits half-used. It's one of the twelve places growth gets stuck, but it's only worth fixing first if it's actually your biggest. Growth Terminal ranks all twelve against your data and tells you whether utilisation is really the one, or a symptom of something upstream.

Diagnose your #1 constraint free. Link in bio.
